model-inventory.title: Why a listed model may not appear
model-inventory.description: The supported model catalog narrows by plan, client surface, administrator policy and release timing before a user sees the model picker.

release-stages.title: Release stages from evaluation to retirement
release-stages.description: Models move from evaluation through private and public preview to general availability and retirement, and preview models stay unconfigured until set.

availability-baseline.title: Predict a model status
availability-baseline.description: Check for an explicit state, then delegation to the default policy, then default exclusions such as open-weight and preview models.

delegation-modes.title: Who decides model access
delegation-modes.description: The enterprise sets model policy and a control mode, then organizations decide delegated models or enterprise teams receive additive access.

provider-hosting.title: Hosting and data statements by provider family
provider-hosting.description: Each provider family has documented hosting and data statements, and none trains on Copilot Business or Enterprise customer data.

retention-exceptions.title: Handle a model outside zero retention
retention-exceptions.description: A model outside the zero data retention agreement stays off unless an exemption is approved and an administrator enables it, then the exception is registered.

auto-selection.title: What Auto can choose
auto-selection.description: Auto removes models outside the plan, disabled models and restricted models, applies the tier preference and bills at the selected model rate.

fusion-routing.title: Fusion execution patterns
fusion-routing.description: Fusion routes a prompt through a Single, Cascade or Critique pattern and returns one response, billed per model used.

model-cost-signals.title: Signals that change model cost
model-cost-signals.description: Token types, long-context tiers, Auto and Fusion discounts, the FedRAMP uplift and promotions change AI credit use, and budgets go to the AI credits process.

bring-your-own-key.title: Two request paths for your own models
bring-your-own-key.description: User BYOK sends requests from the client directly to the provider, while enterprise custom models route through the Copilot API with central keys.

model-review-intake.title: Model intake to decision
model-review-intake.description: A request moves through status, scope, data terms, routing, cost and a scoped pilot before a go, hold or no-go decision.

model-lifecycle-review.title: Lifecycle events to review
model-lifecycle-review.description: Base model designation, automatic enablement within 60 days, LTS terms, retirements and a monthly drift check each trigger a review.
